definitions.explanation: The quality of understanding and caring about others' feelings and needs. Being able to put oneself in another's position and act accordingly.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いやり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to be a considerate person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{思|おも}いやり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感動|かんどう}した→感動：00167_kandou⟧。
examples.english: I was moved by his thoughtfulness.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いやり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{接|せっ}する→接する：12920_sessuru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's important to treat people with consideration.

notes:
{思|おも}いやり is the disposition to imagine what another person is feeling and to act on it before being asked. It is a quality a person has, not an act performed, so it pairs with ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ and ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ rather than with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {思|おも}いやり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a considerate/thoughtful person)
- {思|おも}いやり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have consideration)
- {思|おも}いやり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧ (to lack consideration)
- {思|おも}いやり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧ (a caring heart)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{思|おも}いやり is treated as a core social value in Japan and appears constantly in school mottoes and public messaging. What it emphasizes is anticipating what someone needs without their having to ask — asking outright can itself be seen as putting the other person on the spot.

ETYMOLOGY:
The masu-stem of ⟦{思|おも}いやる→思いやる：25839_omoiyaru⟧ (to sympathize with, to be considerate of) — literally 'to send one's thoughts' out to another person.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{気配|きくば}り→気配り：06688_kikubari⟧ (attentiveness — noticing and acting on small practical needs)
- ⟦{心遣|こころづか}い→心遣い：07296_kokorozukai⟧ (consideration shown in a specific gesture)
- ⟦{優|やさ}しさ→優しさ：25588_yasashisa⟧ (kindness, gentleness — a broader trait)
